localPreparation.prompt: Create one independent scientific-educational hypothetical local landscape on Nix, Pluto's small irregular moon. Wide 16:9 photorealistic illustration, approximately 1672 by 941. This is invented terrain, NOT a reconstruction of a New Horizons image or any mapped site. Independently design grey fine-grained regolith, scattered angular blocks of varied sizes, shallow depressions and a low broken ridge on a gently uneven horizon. Subtle pale patches may suggest ice-like material artistically, but do not show diagnostic crystals, mapped chemistry, measured material fractions, or ammonia as confirmed. Low oblique illumination and exposure are artistic assumptions. Almost black sky is an assumed transparent view, not evidence of absent atmosphere. No Sun, planets, stars, astronomical disks, haze, plumes, liquids, oceans, biology, people, spacecraft, structures or implication of a survivable landing. Do not use or recolour any Moon, Mars, Pluto, Charon, asteroid or other observed body's surface map; no reference images are supplied. No identified Nix crater or permanent Pluto-facing site. Clearly readable unobtrusive footer: 'IMAGINED · LOCAL NIX'. A smaller line: 'Terrain, materials and lighting are assumed'. Maintain natural scientific illustration style and sober grey palette.
localPreparation.inspection: Viewed generated original: legible IMAGINED LOCAL NIX footer and assumptions line; invented grey blocks, grains, low broken ridge and depressions. No astronomical disk, plume, liquid, biology, spacecraft or landing depiction. No observed map input.

Black sky is assumed transparency, not measured atmospheric absence.
